content.text:
{
  "dialogue": "Devon: you get home okay
Me: yeah just walked in like 5 mins ago
Devon: 5th still backed up?
Me: yep by the bank again, so annoying
Devon: i thought they'd be done by now
Me: nope still cones everywhere
Devon: did you end up taking oak instead
Me: nah just sat through it, was too lazy to reroute
Devon: fair, i cut through by the office and it wasn't much better
Me: you just get in too?
Devon: yeah throwing chicken nuggets in the oven lol
Me: fancy dinner tonight
Devon: i know right, peak cooking
Me: i still have that lemon pepper stuff from last week?
Devon: oh you froze it?
Me: yeah finally, otherwise it was gonna go bad
Devon: smart, hey you wanna do pizza this friday
Me: oh yeah i'm down, been craving it again
Devon: rosa's was pretty solid last time
Me: yeah that margherita was so good
Devon: thin crust hit the spot but i want something heavier this time
Me: same, like proper cheesy slices
Devon: have you been to mario's on pine street?
Me: no i don't think so, where's that at
Devon: over by pine, a couple blocks past the library
Me: oh okay, is it good?
Devon: yeah my team ordered from there last week and it was actually really good
Me: better than domino's lol
Devon: oh god anything's better than that sad team lunch
Me: did they ever do another one of those saturday things
Devon: nah everyone complained so they dropped it
Me: good, 2pm on a saturday was criminal
Devon: fr, anyway wanna try mario's friday?
Me: yeah let's do it
Devon: is 6 pm too early for you?
Me: no 6 works perfect, i can head straight from work
Devon: cool same, i can actually leave on time that day
Me: rare lol
Devon: i know, my boss is out so no last minute chart hell
Me: thank god for that
Devon: you still doing autopay for electric?
Me: yeah finally no late fee this month
Devon: nice, mine went through too
Me: adulting win
Devon: lol for real, cat is currently screaming for dinner btw
Me: mine's sitting on my clean laundry again
Devon: they love doing that
Me: it's always the clean load never the dirty one
Devon: same here, zero chill
Me: so friday at mario's then?
Devon: yep, parking in back i think
Me: okay i'll text when i'm leaving the office
Devon: same, i'll grab us a table if i'm first
Me: sounds good, you need anything from the store before then
Devon: nah i did groceries with my mom on the weekend, we're stocked
Me: oh how is she?
Devon: good, still asks about you and that potato salad incident
Me: tell her i said hi, i still think about that potato salad
Devon: lol i will, okay nuggets are done",
  "writer_note": "Kept the evening check-in rhythm and callbacks to traffic, cats, and work gripes to bury the new plan naturally, with Devon proposing Mario's on Pine Street at 6pm and getting a clear short acceptance without reciting the full plan."
}
